contextSelection: All 210 exact retained contexts, including all historical failures and noncanonical sources. No selection using new outcomes.
firstAttempt: Exact pinned input without preparation, native whole-area admission, saved full Normal ordinal and saved timestamp. Never start a whole-area trial at a pre-Baal internal wave boundary.

afterNonwin.skills: In identity signatureByAct order, target rank20 for already learned skills. Then visit learned support targets in pinned growth order, collapsing repeats to their greatest declared rank. Include only source-level-eligible skills with every prerequisite learned in the source. Never learn a new skill, reset or change an existing rank downward. Selection remains fixed even when retries grant a new level.
afterNonwin.stats: Spend complete five-point bundles using the selected build statsPerLevel. Retain the remainder; do not replay statStages or refund old investment.
afterNonwin.priority: Preserve the exact source comboOrder. No conditional combo, area override, new aura selection or caller callback may rewrite it.
afterNonwin.otherPreparation: none: no farm, purchase, craft, socket, merc replacement, formation change, respec, resource edit, grant or reload
afterNonwin.cost: One owned skill point per increment and one owned stat point per stat; exhausted budgets can yield a no-op. Native earned income and once-only quest claims remain part of the contiguous sequence.

execution: Use tests/campaign/retry-measurement.ts after authenticating/hydrating the exact source once. Native entry owns refill; retain all prefix carry, failed-wave time, rewards, quest settlements and actual deltas. Native Return then adapt; never restore between attempts; stop at first victory or attempt3. Initial clock is the source timestamp and advances by ceil(terminalSimClockMs) for each played wave. Normal ordinal advances once per admission modulo360360; native seed hashes canonical area and actual admitted timestamp.
